seller_sync_rows_bounds.name: seller_sync_rows_bounds
seller_sync_rows_bounds.value: "seller_marketplace_sync_rows"."position" between 0 and 999 and "seller_marketplace_sync_rows"."quantity" between 1 and 10000000 and "seller_marketplace_sync_rows"."unit_price" between 0 and 100000000 and "seller_marketplace_sync_rows"."currency"='PHP'

seller_sync_runs_bounds.name: seller_sync_runs_bounds
seller_sync_runs_bounds.value: "seller_marketplace_sync_runs"."status" in ('queued','retrying','running','ready','failed','cancelled') and "seller_marketplace_sync_runs"."attempts" between 0 and 3 and "seller_marketplace_sync_runs"."rows_count" between 0 and 1000 and "seller_marketplace_sync_runs"."from_date"<="seller_marketplace_sync_runs"."to_date"

seller_sync_settings_bounds.name: seller_sync_settings_bounds
seller_sync_settings_bounds.value: "seller_marketplace_sync_settings"."platform" in ('lazada','tiktok') and "seller_marketplace_sync_settings"."interval_minutes" in (60,360,1440) and "seller_marketplace_sync_settings"."lookback_days" between 1 and 7

seller_goods_return_items_bounds.name: seller_goods_return_items_bounds
seller_goods_return_items_bounds.value: "seller_purchase_goods_return_items"."quantity" between 1 and 10000000 and "seller_purchase_goods_return_items"."unit_cost" between 0 and 100000000 and "seller_purchase_goods_return_items"."unit_cost"=round("seller_purchase_goods_return_items"."unit_cost",2)

seller_purchase_items_quantity_check.name: seller_purchase_items_quantity_check
seller_purchase_items_quantity_check.value: "seller_purchase_items"."quantity" between 1 and 10000000 and ("seller_purchase_items"."received_quantity" is null or "seller_purchase_items"."received_quantity" between 0 and "seller_purchase_items"."quantity") and "seller_purchase_items"."unit_cost">=0

seller_stock_adjustments_quantity_check.name: seller_stock_adjustments_quantity_check
seller_stock_adjustments_quantity_check.value: "seller_stock_adjustments"."before" between 0 and 10000000 and "seller_stock_adjustments"."after" between 0 and 10000000 and "seller_stock_adjustments"."before"<>"seller_stock_adjustments"."after"
